description: khuedoan/homelab at 8b9d40f with the one crank the repository performs by hand (system/bootstrap.yml renders and applies system/argocd, first with the github.com seed): creates render:system/argocd, rerouting ApplicationSet argocd/root to github.com, from test/golden/homelab-cranked/crankpath.yaml (crankpath's own text). Reduced form, node ids and counts only. The reduced form counts floating revisions without the note that a chart's two renders differed (three charts of this estate render varying content; docs/limits.md).

mutations.why: without the crank nothing deploys system/argocd: nothing is analysed
without the alias the root ApplicationSet's git generator reads an unreadable repo: it generates nothing, so no cycle

without platform/gitea nothing serves the in-cluster Git host the generated Applications read: the cycle through Gitea goes, and the self-management cycle (root and the Application argocd) is left, cranked
